description: This file defines CLI commands for managing teams in the Mattermost server, including creating, deleting, archiving, restoring, listing, searching, renaming, and modifying team privacy settings.

methods.name: createTeamCmdF
methods.description: Creates a new team with specified name, display name, email, and privacy settings.

methods.name: deleteTeam
methods.description: Performs permanent deletion of a team.

methods.name: listTeamsCmdF
methods.description: Lists all teams on the server, including archived ones.

methods.name: searchTeamCmdF
methods.description: Searches for teams based on provided search terms.

methods.name: removeDuplicatesAndSortTeams
methods.description: Removes duplicate teams and sorts them by name.

methods.name: renameTeamCmdF
methods.description: Renames an existing team and updates its display name.

methods.name: modifyTeamsCmdF
methods.description: Modifies teams' privacy settings to public or private.
